news.title: Bitcoin drops below $67,000 as sell-off intensifies and pessimism grows about crypto's function
news.description: Some market watchers have suggested $70,000 is a key level to watch and a break below that could lead bitcoin to decline further.

news.title: Warren to call for reversal of Trump's UAE chip sales after 'Spy Sheikh' revelations
news.description: President Donald Trump made a deal in May to send 500,000 of the most advanced U.S. AI chips to the United Arab Emirates.

news.title: Trump would decide whether to investigate Fed pick Warsh over refusal to cut rates: Bessent
news.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent left the door open to suing Kevin Warsh as Fed chair in testimony to the Senate Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs Committee.
